title: Printable Friendsgiving Leftovers Labels
summary: Easily download these Vi-Toile Mama Hen Wallpapers for your phone or desktop, just in time for Mother's Day!
body_markdown:
Hosting a Friendsgiving? Send everyone home in style with their very own thoughtfully labeled leftovers. Open the PDF using the button below, print and cut out a batch for friends to jot down their goodies so they don’t leave any morsels behind- because leftovers are for quitters!


[Print your own Friendsgiving Labels](https://vitalfarms.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/2511-MISC-LeftoversBlog-PrintableTags.pdf)


Let’s see those leftovers! Tag us @vitalfarms and show us your labels in action!
